_about: The Events page at /dallas/events/ (engine/events_page.py). 'file' is the page's listing, written daily by fetch_happening.py next to the page; 'units' is the map's file the ZIP filter and card outline come from. Its one source, Dallas Park and Recreation's calendars, is used under the non-commercial rule (NONCOMMERCIAL.md). 'words' are the page's own text; the engine names no city or source. 'shows' (November 15, 2026) adds the big venues' concerts, games and shows from the Venues listing (docs/<city>/venues/shows.json) with a switch at the top; its title, intro, desc and card replace the words'.

words.title: What’s on in Dallas parks
words.intro: Dallas Park and Recreation’s public events for the next 30 days, from its own calendars: Fair Park, Old City Park, recreation centers, outdoor programs and more. Some take place outside the city, at parks the City runs.
words.listing: A listing, not a guide: the facts and a link to each event’s page, nothing else. The library publishes no feed, so its programs aren’t here.
words.desc: What’s on in Dallas parks today, this weekend and this month: Dallas Park and Recreation’s public events, by ZIP code.
words.card: Today, this weekend, the next 30 days
words.source: Events from Dallas Park and Recreation’s calendars (dallasparks.org).

shows.title: What’s on in Dallas
shows.intro: Concerts, games and shows at the big venues across Dallas–Fort Worth, plus Dallas Park and Recreation’s public events for the next 30 days, from its own calendars: Fair Park, Old City Park, recreation centers, outdoor programs and more. Some take place outside the city, at parks the City runs.
shows.desc: What’s on in Dallas today, this weekend and this week: concerts, games and shows at the big DFW venues, and Dallas Park and Recreation’s events.
shows.card: Big venues, community events, the next 30 days
shows.source: Shows at the big venues from Ticketmaster.
